summary: Flat kerb with bush opposite; homes 15-20 m behind on the same side.

best_section.where: Sixth Avenue south kerb, midway along the straight below the steep bend, bush opposite

drivers.seclusion: Bushland across the road; detached homes 15 m to 20 m behind the kerb on its own side, set back behind driveways and grass.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge and driveways beside the kerb, so a van can stop clear of the lane; one car was seen parked along it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Signs near the top give a No Stopping Any Time zone and 2P resident-permit parking on Central Avenue; none on this straight, and few cars park here.

flags: Homes within about 20 m on own side
No Stopping Any Time sign near the junction at the start
Steep elsewhere: 8% mean, up to 30% on the first 60 m
Dense bush opposite, possible fire risk
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the north side; the section is open to the sky and the afternoon sun from the west.
rubbish: Possible dumped items under the trees beside the kerb at 235-265 m, not at the best section.
cannot_judge: Whether the bush pull-in at 235-265 m is passable
